title: THE DAY I BECAME THE SCHOOL SNACK KING 👑
topic: The ultimate resolution of the vending machine business empire.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: I AM OFFICIALLY THE NEW BOSS OF THIS ENTIRE HIGH SCHOOL CAFETERIA [beat] AND THERE IS NOTHING YOU CAN DO TO STOP ME!

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: This is a gross violation of every school policy we have [beat] Nix, you better explain right now how a teenager managed to buy every vending machine on campus!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: It wasn't just luck or pocket money [beat] remember that old midnight scooter I spent months fixing up? I didn't want it for racing, I wanted it for logistics!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: You're just a loser with a rusty bike [beat] there's no way a kid like you outbid my dad's professional vending company for the school contract!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Your dad's company was lazy and ignored the late-night maintenance clauses [beat] so I used my scooter to service every machine while the city was asleep.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: Nix discovered that the old vending company was hemorrhaging money [beat] simply because they couldn't keep up with the 3 AM demand for energy drinks.

lines.speaker: joy
lines.text: I saw him out there every single night [beat] restocking the chips and the cold sodas while everyone else was busy dreaming about passing their math finals.

lines.speaker: jamal
lines.text: I provided the seed money for my nephew to close the deal [beat] but only because he showed me a business plan that actually had legs, or wheels in this case.

lines.speaker: huda
lines.text: You might technically own the machines [beat] but I can still give you a month of detention for conducting a private business during my chemistry class!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Go ahead and try to punish me [beat] because I just signed a new contract that gives the teachers free premium coffee as long as I stay in charge.

lines.speaker: narrator
lines.text: The principal suddenly realized that her morning double-shot latte was now under the total control [beat] of the student she just tried to suspend.

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Call me the Snack King [beat] because from now on, if you want a chocolate bar or a bag of chips, you have to follow my rules first!

lines.speaker: bruno
lines.text: This is totally unfair and I'm going to go hungry just to prove a point [beat] I'm never buying a single snack from your machines again!

lines.speaker: nix
lines.text: Good luck with that, Bruno [beat] because I just replaced the gym lockers with high-speed snack dispensers that only take my customized currency!
